detail: trisc0 .data overflow 0x8b0>0x720: constant Mm descriptor per mm_block call site materialized in .data
mm() takes flag word + scalar operand args; no per-call-site aggregate

verdict: gather-bound (~54%); R3 page-harvest is the structural lever

what: Compute kernels with many call sites passing a constant aggregate (struct of CB ids/offsets) to a noipa block function get each aggregate materialized in .data, which lives in TRISC local data memory (0x720 B on BH); fails at ELF load with overflows region:1 ... reduce thread_local, only under --dev in my case. Not documented.
suggest: Add a note to a kernel-authoring reference: TRISC .data/.rodata is local memory (~1.8 KB); pass block descriptors as scalar args / flag words, not constant structs per call site.

what: Shell env sets TT_MESH_GRAPH_DESC_PATH to p150 (1-chip) descriptor on a 2-chip p300a box; every device open fails with Physical chip id 0 not found in control plane chip mapping, including for pre-existing ops.
suggest: Fix the env or have run_safe_pytest.sh warn/unset when the mesh descriptor does not match the detected board.
